# 📊 STRATEGIC SEO AUDIT REPORT

**Generated by:** F9XR SEO Audit Task Force  
**Generated on:** 2026-09-17  
**Audit Scope:** Local Repository Codebase — The DESI Sikka (Jekyll static site on GitHub Pages)  
**Site:** https://ttearncrypto.github.io/thedesisikka/

---

## Project Overview

- **Site type:** Crypto news publication (YMYL-adjacent). Static Jekyll build, GitHub Pages, baseurl `/thedesisikka`.
- **Pages audited:** 56 rendered pages in `_site` (19 news posts, 9 category pages, 5 legal, 2 author, 8 body pages, 5 learn guides, homepage, archive, press, 404, plus feeds/robots/sitemap/assets).
- **Primary target queries:** News and informational crypto queries (`binance wotd answers`, `hyundai stablecoin avalanche`, `crypto news india`, stablecoin/DeFi explainers) with a strong India geo-angle (30% tax, 1% TDS, RBI, FIU).
- **Audience/geography:** Global + India crypto readers; traffic intent is Google News / Discover / AdSense monetization.
- **Audit date:** 2026-09-17.

---

## Executive Summary

The site's **technical and structured-data foundation is strong**: every page has a canonical, single H1, responsive meta, NewsArticle JSON-LD with all Google-required fields, BreadcrumbList, Organization + WebSite/SearchAction schema, a valid sitemap (44 URLs, 0 broken mappings), a healthy robots.txt, and zero broken footer/nav internal links. AEO/GEO foundations (question-formatted H2s, 40–60-word first-paragraph answers, defined jargon, llms.txt) are present and unusually well executed on the daily posts.

**The ranking risk concentrates in three areas:**

1. **Indexation/cannibalization** — two pairs of duplicate indexable pages (`/press/` + `/category/press/`, `/pages/todays-combo/` + `/category/todays-combo/`), an empty indexable `/category/bitcoin/`, and 15 near-identical daily WOTD posts splitting one query cluster across 15 URLs.
2. **CTR/snippet hygiene** — 8+ indexable pages have title tags that will truncate in Google SERPs (up to 80 chars), and the homepage title is a bare brand name.
3. **Discover/Google News readiness** — feeds ship full text but no per-item images/enclosures, and freshness signals (`dateModified`, `article:modified_time`) are structurally dead because no post sets `last_modified_at`.

**Total issues found:** 17 (2 Critical, 3 High, 7 Medium, 5 Low).  
**Single most important action:** Fix the E5 duplicate-page cannibalization (`/press/` vs `/category/press/`) — it is the only issue that actively suppresses two indexable pages today, and the fix is one `robots:` line.

## Quick Wins (can be implemented in <30 mins)

1. **Block duplicate `/press/` category-index pairing.** Add `robots: "noindex, follow"` + `sitemap: false` to `category/press.md` or `press/index.md` — pick one keeper (recommend keeping `/press/` section, de-prioritizing `/category/press/`).
2. **Same for `/pages/todays-combo/` vs `/category/todays-combo/`** — de-index one URL.
3. **Put `opencode.json`, `seo_audit_report.*`, `scripts/`, `bharat-by-day.html` in `_config.yml` `exclude:`** to stop publishing internal files to the live site.
4. **Add `robots: "noindex, follow"` + `sitemap: false` to `category/bitcoin.md`** until that category has real content.
5. **Set an SEO title on `index.md`** (`title:` front matter) and shorten the 5 learn-guide titles.
6. **Noindex `bharat-by-day`** is already covered by page meta; the robots.txt `Disallow: /bharat-by-day/` belt-and-braces line takes 10 seconds.

## Granular Pillar Evaluations

### 1. On-Page SEO
- **Files Audited:** `_includes/head.html`, `_layouts/post.html`, `_layouts/home.html`, `_layouts/category.html`, all `_posts/*.md`, all `pages/*.md`, `legal/*.md`, `category/*.md`, `index.md`
- **Passed Checks:** Every page has a title + description. Single H1. Sequential headings. Canonical on every page. Keyword placed in title/H1/slug/first-para/H2 on news posts (4–5/5). Descriptions 100–158 chars on most indexables. No keyword stuffing detected.
- **Issues Found:**

  - **Issue 1: Cross-page cannibalization — two indexable URLs per content set** *(High — finding #2)*
    - **Location:** `/press/` (`press/index.md`) + `/category/press/` (`category/press.md`); `/pages/todays-combo/` (`pages/todays-combo.md`) + `/category/todays-combo/` (`category/todays-combo.md`)
    - **Problem:** Both the section pages and their category twins are indexable in `_site/sitemap.xml` and render the same post lists ("Today's Combo", "Press Releases"). Two URLs compete for the identical query cluster; neither fully ranks.
    - **Current Code:** `pages/todays-combo.md` → `layout: section` (no `robots` key). `category/todays-combo.md` → `layout: category`, `cat_slug: todays-combo` (no `robots` key).
    - **Root Cause:** Two template paths (`section` layout + `category` layout) were built for the same taxonomy, both left indexable. Google ranks pages, not sites — split internal equity.
    - **Ranking Impact:** Direct keyword-cannibalization risk on "today's combo" and "press releases" queries; each page's link equity is halved.
    - **Fix:**
      ```yaml
      # category/todays-combo.md — add:
      robots: "noindex, follow"
      sitemap: false

      # category/press.md — add:
      robots: "noindex, follow"
      sitemap: false
      ```
      (Keep `/pages/todays-combo/` and `/press/` as the canonical sections — they are the ones referenced in the header/footer nav.)
    - **Implementation Guidance:** Edit both files' front matter; rebuild; verify the de-indexed URLs drop out of `_site/sitemap.xml` and gain `noindex, follow` robots meta.
    - **Fix Type:** indexability / metadata
    - **Verification:** `jekyll build`, then confirm `_site/sitemap.xml` no longer contains `category/press/` or `category/todays-combo/`, and those pages in `_site` carry `<meta name="robots" content="noindex, follow">`.

  - **Issue 2: Empty indexable `/category/bitcoin/`; thin `/category/defi/` (2 posts) and `/category/press/` (1 post)** *(Critical — finding #1)*
    - **Location:** `category/bitcoin.md` (indexable, 0 posts), `category/defi.md`, `category/press.md`
    - **Problem:** `/category/bitcoin/` renders the empty-state `Nothing published in this category yet.` while being indexable (in sitemap, no robots). Google treats near-empty pages as thin content. Meanwhile sibling empty categories (`ethereum`, `altcoins`, `exchanges`, `regulation`) were correctly `noindex`ed — an inconsistency.
    - **Current Code:** `category/bitcoin.md` has `layout: category`, `cat_slug: bitcoin`, no `robots` key. The layout renders the empty note because `site.categories.bitcoin < 1`.
    - **Root Cause:** Bitcoin is the highest-intent category for a crypto news site and was presumably left indexable in anticipation of content, but 0 posts have shipped since launch (2026-09-01).
    - **Ranking Impact:** Thin-content risk on the brand's flagship category URL.
    - **Fix:** Either (a) immediately seed ≥3 Bitcoin stories, or (b) until then:
      ```yaml
      # category/bitcoin.md — add:
      robots: "noindex, follow"
      sitemap: false
      ```
    - **Implementation Guidance:** If content ships within 2 weeks, skip the noindex and publish; otherwise apply (b).
    - **Fix Type:** indexability
    - **Verification:** Remove the URL from sitemap; noindex meta present on the rendered page.

  - **Issue 3: Title-tag truncation on 8 indexable pages** *(High — finding #3)*
    - **Location:** `pages/learn/bitcoin-tax-guide-india.md` (80), `pages/learn/exchange-comparison-india.md` (73), `pages/learn/wallet-and-security.md` (72), `pages/learn/glossary.md` (71), `pages/learn/p2p-and-onramps.md` (74), `_posts/2026-09-17-hyundai-scales-stablecoin-payments-on-avalanche.md` (72), `_posts/2026-09-01-predict-fun-developer-dashboard.md` (70), `_posts/2026-09-01-welcome-to-the-desi-sikka.md` (69). All WOTD posts sit at 61–62 chars (borderline).
    - **Problem:** `head.html:6-10` renders `{page.title} | The DESI Sikka`. Google truncates around 60 chars (~580px), so roughly the last 10–20 chars — including "The DESI Sikka" brand — get cut, and the keyword tail of the learn-title is lost.
    - **Current Code:** `_includes/head.html:7` → `<title>{{ page.title | escape }}{% if site.title_separator %} {{ site.title_separator }} {% endif %}{{ site.title | escape }}</title>`
    - **Root Cause:** Multi-clause titles + unconditional brand suffix.
    - **Ranking Impact:** CTR loss from truncated snippets (title length is correlated with reduced CTR once clipped; Moz/Sistrix truncation data).
    - **Fix:** Introduce a per-page `seo_title` and shorten the long page titles:
      ```yaml
      # pages/learn/bitcoin-tax-guide-india.md
      title: "Bitcoin Tax Guide for India (2026)"
      # rendered: "Bitcoin Tax Guide for India (2026) | The DESI Sikka" — 49 chars ✓

      # _posts/2026-09-17: shorten title at the source OR add
      # Optionally, use a custom front-matter title variable in head.html:
      ```
      And extend `head.html` to honor an explicit SEO title:
      ```liquid
      {% if page.seo_title %}
        <title>{{ page.seo_title | escape }}</title>
      {% elsif page.title and page.title != site.title %}
        <title>{{ page.title | escape }}{% if site.title_separator %} {{ site.title_separator }} {% endif %}{{ site.title | escape }}</title>
      {% else %}
        <title>{{ site.title | escape }}</title>
      {% endif %}
      ```
    - **Implementation Guidance:** Add `seo_title:` to the 5 learn guides and 3 long posts (or shorten `title:` where sensible), keeping ≤60 chars including brand.
    - **Fix Type:** metadata
    - **Verification:** Rebuild; grep `_site` for `<title>` lengths; target ≤60 chars on all indexables.

  - **Issue 4: Homepage title is bare brand** *(Medium — finding #12)*
    - **Location:** `index.md`
    - **Problem:** `index.md` has no `title` → `<title>The DESI Sikka</title>` (14 chars). The homepage — the highest-traffic URL — squanders its title slot.
    - **Current Code:** `index.md` front matter has only `layout: home` + `description`.
    - **Fix:**
      ```yaml
      # index.md
      title: "Crypto News Today — Bitcoin, Ethereum & India"
      ```
      Renders: `Crypto News Today — Bitcoin, Ethereum & India | The DESI Sikka` (57 chars). H1 remains the hero headline unaffected.
    - **Fix Type:** metadata

### 2. Technical SEO
- **Files Audited:** `robots.txt`, `_site/sitemap.xml`, `_layouts/default.html`, `security.txt`, `.well-known/security.txt`, `_config.yml`
- **Passed Checks:** Canonical on every page; robots.txt has clean allow/disallow + sitemap directive + AI-bot allows; sitemap (44 URLs) maps 1:1 to files (0 missing, 0 broken); no parameterized URLs; no noindex+sitemap conflicts except the duplicates above; correct `lang="en"`; staging references: none.
- **Issues Found:**

  - **Issue 5: Deployed-as-public build artifacts + orphan demo page** *(Medium — finding #9)*
    - **Location:** `_site/opencode.json`, `_site/seo_audit_report.md`, `_site/seo_audit_report.csv`, `_site/scripts/`, `_site/bharat-by-day/`
    - **Problem:** `_config.yml` `exclude:` omits these, so internal config, a full prior audit, and a React/Tailwind component demo (unrelated crypto content) are published to the live domain root. The demo page is not in robots.txt allow/disallow rules (only page-level `noindex` protects it).
    - **Current Code:** `_config.yml` lines 137-142 exclude only `skills/`, `todo.txt`, `Gemfile`, `Gemfile.lock`, `README.md`.
    - **Fix:**
      ```yaml
      exclude:
        - skills/
        - todo.txt
        - Gemfile
        - Gemfile.lock
        - README.md
        - opencode.json
        - seo_audit_report.md
        - seo_audit_report.csv
        - scripts/
        - bharat-by-day.html
        - seo_audit.html
      ```
    - **Fix Type:** config
    - **Verification:** Rebuild and confirm the six paths no longer exist under `_site`.

### 3. Performance SEO (Core Web Vitals)
- **Files Audited:** `_includes/head.html`, `assets/main.css`, `assets/site.js`, all article images
- **Passed Checks:** Google Fonts preconnected + async (`media="print" onload`); analytics async; post hero `loading="eager" fetchpriority="high"` with explicit 1200x675 dims (LCP handled); all below-fold images have `loading="lazy"` + dimensions; `font-display: swap` via Google CSS link; `defer` on `site.js`; no render-blocking JS.
- **Issues Found:**

  - **Issue 6: Oversized hero/social images** *(Medium — finding #11)*
    - **Location:** `assets/site-images/logo.png` (624.6 KB), `assets/articles-images/predictfun-developer-dashboard-hero.jpg` (366.3 KB)
    - **Problem:** `logo.png` is the `og:image`-fallback-relevant, publisher-logo schema target, feed image, *and* the `welcome-to-the-desi-sikka` post cover — at 624 KB it will be the LCP image on that post and a slow social share. The predictfun hero (366 KB, 1200px) is that post's LCP and is 3.4× heavier than a properly compressed WebP.
    - **Current Code:** `_posts/2026-09-01-welcome-to-the-desi-sikka.md:13` → `cover_image: /assets/site-images/logo.png`
    - **Fix:** Re-encode both to WebP/AVIF at 1200px:
      - `logo.png` → `assets/site-images/logo.webp` (~150 KB) and update the welcome post `cover_image`.
      - `predictfun-developer-dashboard-hero.jpg` → `assets/articles-images/predictfun-developer-dashboard-hero.webp` (~100 KB).
    - **Fix Type:** performance
    - **Verification:** Check file sizes; re-render post page; verify `og:image` still resolves.

  - **Issue 7: Unminified CSS/JS** *(Low — finding #15)*
    - **Location:** `assets/main.css` (52 KB), `assets/site.js` (16 KB)
    - **Fix:** Add a post-build minification step (e.g., GitHub Action running `purgecss`/`csso` + `terser`, or serve pre-minified copies). Low priority — page weight is already modest. Swap note: keep `main.css` uncritical for a ~all static above-the-fold so minification shows up mostly in transfer time.

### 7. Semantic SEO & Content Optimization
- **Files Audited:** all 19 posts, 5 learn guides, homepage
- **Passed Checks:** Direct-answer first paragraphs (40–60 words) on 18/19 posts (the Hyundai + all 15 WOTD posts pass; Welcome fails); question-style H2s (WOTD 5/6, Hyundai 4/6); jargon defined on first use (stablecoin, WOTD); entity density strong on Hyundai (~7 entities in first 2 ¶), adequate on WOTD; `faq:` blocks on WOTD posts render FAQPage schema; scannable formatting (bullets, bold, callouts).
- **Issues Found:**

  - **Issue 9: 15 near-duplicate WOTD pages (keyword cannibalization + low information gain)** *(High — finding #4)*
    - **Location:** `_posts/2026-09-01` … `2026-09-16` `binance-wotd-*.md` (16 files; 15 near-duplicate)
    - **Problem:** Bodies are byte-similar (identical description lengths 152–156; identical 800+ word body templates; same `summary` bullets structure; only the date + answer words change). All 15 target the same query family (`binance wotd answers`, `binance word of the day <date>`). Google sees a 15-page near-duplicate cluster — ranking is split, and a Discover/Google News submission could flag this as duplicate-velocity.
    - **Current Code:** `_posts/2026-09-16-binance-wotd-september-16-2026.md:2-8` (identical structure across series)
    - **Fix (choose one):**
      - **Recommended:** Build a **Binance WOTD hub page** (`/pages/binance-wotd-answers/`) listing all daily answer posts, and set the older 14 posts to `robots: noindex, follow` keeping only the current week indexable + canonicalized to the hub.
      - **Minimum viable:** Add unique per-post differentiation (a distinct intro paragraph explaining that day's theme change; unique FAQ entity) and keep only the latest ~5 posts indexable.
    - **Fix Type:** content / indexability
    - **Ranking Impact:** Concentrating the cluster wins the featured snippet + Discover card instead of splitting the vote 15 ways.

  - **Issue 10: Welcome post first paragraph fails AEO answer test** *(Low — finding #16)*
    - **Location:** `_posts/2026-09-01-welcome-to-the-desi-sikka.md:18`
    - **Problem:** First paragraph (≈24 words) is a manifesto hook, not an answer. For GEO/AEO extraction it should answer "what/who/when" in 40–60 words.
    - **Current Code:** `Crypto news moves fast. Most of it reads like it was written for people who already know the jargon. The DESI Sikka flips that.`
    - **Fix:** Lead with the factual answer: `The DESI Sikka is a global crypto news desk that publishes bitcoin, ethereum, altcoin, DeFi, regulation and exchange coverage in plain English, with deep India reporting — launched on September 1, 2026 with a simple rule: crypto news, zero jargon.`

  - **Issue 11: 4 noindex, empty category pages linked from footer + llms.txt** *(Medium — finding #10)*
    - **Location:** `_includes/footer.html:19-21` (iterates all 9 `site_categories`)
    - **Problem:** Footer links to `/category/ethereum/`, `/category/altcoins/`, `/category/regulation/`, `/category/exchanges/` — all `noindex` with zero content (they render the empty-state). Crawl budget + a little link equity are spent on dead pages on every page load.
    - **Fix:** Filter the footer to indexable categories only:
      ```liquid
      {% for cat in site.site_categories %}
        {% if cat.indexable != false %}
          <a href="{{ '/category/' | append: cat.slug | relative_url }}">{{ cat.name }}</a>
        {% endif %}
      {% endfor %}
      ```
      (Add/tune `indexable:` semantics or maintain a `footer_categories:` list in `_config.yml`.) Or seed the categories with content (long-term strategy above) so they become indexable and worth linking.
    - **Fix Type:** linking / structural

### 9. XML Sitemap & Robots.txt
- **Files Audited:** `robots.txt`, `_site/sitemap.xml`, `_config.yml`
- **Passed Checks:** robots.txt valid with `Sitemap:` directive; AI-bot allow rules; search/404/feeds disallowed; sitemap covers every indexable page; no indexable page missing from sitemap.
- **Issues Found:**
  - `sitemap.xml` lacks `<lastmod>` on category/static/author/legal/hub entries (Low — finding #13). Fix handles the classification pages at `_data` or plugin config; honestly cosmetic until content cadence is high — deprioritize.
  - `robots.txt` lacks `Disallow: /bharat-by-day/` (belt-and-braces; covered by page noindex; Low).

### 10. Social & Regional SEO
- **Files Audited:** `_includes/head.html`
- **Passed Checks:** OG + Twitter cards on every page; `og:type` article/website; `article:published_time`; `article:section`; `twitter:card=summary_large_image`; `twitter:site`; locale correct.
- **Issues Found:**
  - `og:image:width`/`height` only emitted for the site-default image (Medium — finding #7). Post covers (1200x675) work, but declaring dimensions helps pre-parse. Fix: emit width/height when a cover is present:
    ```liquid
    {% if page.cover_image or page.image %}
      <meta property="og:image:width" content="1200">
      <meta property="og:image:height" content="675">
    {% endif %}
    ```

### 11. Security SEO
- **Files Audited:** repo + `_site`
- **Passed Checks:** No mixed content; all canonical/OG URLs `https://`; external links `rel="noopener"`; no `http://` actions in forms.
- **Issues Found:**
  - `security.txt:4` `Canonical:` → `.well-known/security.txt` 404s in `_site` (Low — finding #14). Jekyll drops dot-directories unless `include`. Fix: add `.well-known` to `_config.yml` `include:`, or drop the Canonical line. (Security-file reachability; harmless to SEO but worth matching the canonical you claim.)

### 12. Accessibility (a11y)
- **Files Audited:** layouts, includes
- **Passed Checks:** `lang="en"`; skip-link; landmark elements; `aria-label`s on nav/search/menus; focus-visible styles; contrast compliant (dark theme); alt text present. Good.

### 14. Blog & Content SEO + 14a. Crypto-news specifics
- **Files Audited:** all posts, feeds, `_data/authors.yml`
- **Passed Checks:** NewsArticle schema complete (headline, image, datePublished, dateModified, author, publisher, mainEntityOfPage, isAccessibleForFree all present — `post.html:281-324`); `wordCount`; single H1; reading time; share buttons; related news; author attribution with Person/Organization types; sources cited on Hyundai post; opinions correctly absent so far.
- **Issues Found:**

  - **Issue 12: Freshness signals never fire** *(Medium — finding #5)*
    - **Location:** `_includes/head.html:45` + `_layouts/post.html:289`; none of the 19 posts set `last_modified_at`
    - **Problem:** `article:modified_time` meta is omitted and JSON-LD `dateModified` falls back to `datePublished` on every post. Google News/Discover penalize stale news by recency; you are leaving the freshness signal on the table every time a story is updated.
    - **Fix:**
      ```yaml
      # front matter, applied whenever you update a story:
      last_modified_at: 2026-09-17T14:30:00+05:30
      ```
      Optionally add a build-default in `_config.yml` defaults for posts. Also consider emitting `article:modified_time` with a date fallback:
      ```liquid
      <meta property="article:modified_time" content="{{ page.last_modified_at | default: page.date | date_to_xmlschema }}">
      ```
    - **Fix Type:** schema / metadata

  - **Issue 13: Opinion-vs-news compliance is policy-only** *(Medium — finding #8)*
    - **Location:** `_layouts/post.html:284` (`@type` switch gated on `page.opinion`)
    - **Problem:** The site's editorial rules and `pages/predictions.md` promise that predictions ship labeled as opinion — but `page.opinion` is set nowhere and nothing switches on the `prediction` tag. A future prediction story would silently emit `NewsArticle` and skip the on-page "Opinion" label.
    - **Fix:** Add a build-time guard in `_layouts/post.html`:
      ```liquid
      {% assign is_prediction = page.tags | join: ',' | downcase | split: ',' | contains: 'prediction' %}
      {% if page.opinion or is_prediction %}@type/Opinion-label{% endif %}
      ```
      And codify in the publishing checklist: any `tags: [prediction]` post MUST set `opinion: true`.

  - **Issue 14: Feeds under-serve Discover/Google News (no images)** *(Medium — finding #6)*
    - **Location:** `rss.xml`, `atom.xml` (no per-item image), `_includes/head.html:91` (Atom autodiscovery → `/feed.xml` plugin file, not custom `/atom.xml`)
    - **Problem:** Google News/Discover ingestion routes through feeds; without an image element (`<media:content>`/enclosure or `<image>`), the platform can't build rich cards from the feed. Full text `content:encoded` is present (good) — images are the missing piece.
    - **Fix (rss.xml item):**
      ```xml
      {% if post.cover_image or post.image %}
      <media:content url="{{ (post.cover_image | default: post.image) | absolute_url }}" medium="image" type="image/jpeg"/>
      <enclosure url="{{ (post.cover_image | default: post.image) | absolute_url }}" type="image/jpeg"/>
      {% endif %}
      ```
      (add `xmlns:media="http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/"` to the `<rss>` tag), and point the `<link rel="alternate" type="application/atom+xml">` at `/atom.xml` to match the canonical custom feed.
    - **Fix Type:** feeds / config

### 15 / 16. Security-adjacent & build config
- Covered by findings #9 and #14.

- **Files Audited:** `llms.txt`, `llms-full.txt`, all posts
- **Passed Checks:** `llms.txt` present with sections/policies/contact; `llms-full.txt` auto-generates per-post summaries; AI-chips row (ChatGPT/Gemini/Claude/Perplexity) with prefilled summarize prompts; `speakable` spec; entity-dense copy; disclaimers present; no contradictions found.
